source_summary: Ink monochrome Chinese landscape with jagged mountain masses at left and center, bare winter trees, a small boat on open water, a foreground rocky bank with leaning pines, and distant right-side snowy hills with conifers. Calligraphy in the upper right is excluded.

motifs.name: left_jagged_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the tall left cluster of steep, jagged mountains and adjacent mist-softened foothills, excluding the foreground shoreline trees where they cross in front.
must_preserve: broken ink outlines on vertical cliff faces
soft gray wash gradients inside the peaks
dark textured crevices along the left flank
small dark tree strokes on ridge tops
misty lower edge where the massif dissolves into the bank

motifs.name: central_needle_crags
motifs.description: Isolate the central serrated crag group with the high peak, descending cliff planes, narrow clefts, and pale lower rock forms; omit nearby foreground pine and shore grove.
must_preserve: angular contour linework on the peak edges
dry-brush rock texture and vertical fissures
dark ink accents in ravines
soft wash transitions on the lower cliff
irregular broken silhouette against the open sky

motifs.name: leafless_shore_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the winter grove on the left-middle shoreline: bare trunks, twiggy branches, sparse dark foliage marks, and the low rocky bank beneath them.
must_preserve: thin calligraphic branch linework
clustered vertical trunks of varied weight
small dark leaf or needle dots
low horizontal bank contour
rocky mounds with dry-brush texture at the base

motifs.name: small_left_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the tiny boat floating in the lower-left water, including its curved hull, seated figures or dark marks, and slight water strokes around it.
must_preserve: delicate curved hull line
tiny dark figure-like strokes inside the boat
short horizontal water ripples
minimal pale space around the boat needed to retain scale

motifs.name: foreground_leaning_pine_group
motifs.description: Isolate the prominent foreground pine group on the rocky bank: two tall leaning trunks, spreading branch canopy, sparse needles, exposed roots, and small companion branches.
must_preserve: paired leaning trunks with dark contour strokes
radiating pine branch structure
fine needle clusters and twig tips
root lines descending into the rocks
dark-to-light ink variation in the trunk wash

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_snow_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the broad foreground rocky bank beneath and around the pine base, with rounded snow-like mounds, dark rock accents, and soft lower shoreline washes.
must_preserve: rounded mound contours
dry-brush stippling and dark rock cracks
soft gray wash shadows under the bank
irregular broken edge along the water
small dark vegetation accents among the rocks

motifs.name: right_distant_conifer_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the distant right-side rolling hills with clusters of small conifers and bare trees along the ridge, excluding the calligraphy above.
must_preserve: low undulating hill outlines
tiny vertical conifer silhouettes
repeated dark needle marks
pale wash on snowy slopes
mist-softened horizontal base line

motifs.name: open_river_mist_bands
motifs.description: Isolate the open water and mist bands running across the lower half of the painting, including horizontal shoreline contours and soft wash transitions, while masking out boat, trees, rocks, and mountain forms.
must_preserve: long horizontal ink contour lines
soft gray atmospheric wash
blank water reserves between banks
feathered mist edges around landforms
subtle tonal shifts separating near water from distant shore

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
